summary:
Iter 8 (staff JWT + per-role guards on legacy endpoints) frontend regression + backend spot-check PASS 100%. All 12 requested scenarios verified end-to-end against the public preview URL.

BACKEND SPOT-CHECK (5/5 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_security_iter8_spot.py, junit at test_reports/pytest/iter8_spot.xml): GET /api/menu 200 (public), GET /api/orders no-token 401, GET /api/orders kitchen token 200, GET /api/reports/closing kitchen token 403, GET /api/reports/closing manager token 200. Staff login returns {access_token, role, label} for all 6 PINs (manager 1234, kitchen 2345, phone 3456, driver1 1111, driver2 2222, driver3 3333).

FRONTEND (1024x900 unless noted, fresh session -> /staff/login):
  1) MANAGER 1234: PIN login -> /staff dashboard (staff-filter-progress shows 39 in-progress + 55 nouvelles + 5 terminées; NO auth error toast). Opened staff-filter-new, opened first NEW order (staff-order-card-*), staff-accept-15 -> staff-accept-confirm -> success (nouvelles count decreased from 56 -> 55). staff-go-kitchen -> Cuisine screen with 30+ cards. staff-go-customers -> /staff/customers, customers-search-input '079' -> 40 matching rows rendered. staff-go-closing -> /staff/closing loads (closing-title + sources-report visible). staff-go-admin -> /staff/admin, admin-cat-* + admin-product-* rows visible; opened first admin-product-* -> product-editor-title screen, clicked editor-save with no changes -> navigated back to /staff/admin (PATCH allowed as manager, no 403).
  2) KITCHEN 2345: dashboard loads (55 nouvelles, 0 admin/closing chips shown), accept-15 -> confirm succeeds (200, no 403 in body). /staff/customers as kitchen renders empty state (no crash, no red screen, body length 36) - server correctly returns 403, UI degrades gracefully.
  3) PHONE 3456: PIN login -> /phone-orders with station picker; picked Poste 1. phone-search-input '0791751450' -> phone-result-6aa9a1e5cd10bff6d4c6a274 (Anna Rossi). Selected result, phone-cat-boissons -> phone-product-6aa94a928068d15c2420fa0c (Coca-Cola) added. phone-pane-order -> phone-confirm -> phone-success #523 modal. phone-success-ticket -> /staff/ticket/6aa9c5525e5ce896667f62f4 renders full ticket text (676 chars: HALLO MAGIC PIZZA, R E T R A I T, #523, PRET 00:53, Source: TELEPHONE - POSTE 1, A ENCAISSER CHF 3.50 ESPECES, 1x COCA-COLA, CLIENT: ANNA ROSSI, TEL: 0791751450, Ticket operationnel). Phone role allowed on /staff/ticket/<id> per spec.
  4) DRIVER 1111: PIN login -> /driver, driver-title='Livreur 1', 29 driver-order-* cards, no 401 or unauthorized text.
  5) CUSTOMER 390x844 (no login): home menu loads with product-card-* / product-add-* testIDs; product-add on Margherita -> customization sheet -> add-to-cart-button. tab-cart -> cart-checkout-button -> /checkout. Filled checkout-first-name TEST_Guest + checkout-phone 0796000222, ASAP retrait pickup, confirm-order-button -> /order/6aa9c5c05e5ce896667f62f6 (public GET /orders/{id} works). Tracker rendered with 'En attente de confirmation' + timeline (Acceptée/En préparation/Prête à retirer/Retirée) + Articles 1x Margherita 32cm CHF 14.00 + Paiement au retrait + TVA 2.6% breakdown. /orders tab (public GET /orders?ids=) shows the freshly created #524 with Retrait · 00:25 · 1 articles / 1x Margherita / CHF 14.00.

Regression-safe: no destructive PUTs run. All test data prefixed TEST_ (customer phone 0796000222 guest).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still firing on every screen: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' RN 0.76+ deprecates shadow* on web. Cosmetic. Same finding as iter7. Reference: any file using shadowColor in StyleSheet.create() – grep 'shadowColor' /app/frontend/src /app/frontend/app.

action_items: OPTIONAL – Migrate deprecated shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence RN warnings (cosmetic only; not blocking).

OPTIONAL – The iter7 CRITICAL bug (orders.client_request_id unique index treats null as duplicate) is orthogonal to this iter's security scope. If not yet fixed, still recommended: drop_index('client_request_id_1') then create_index with partialFilterExpression={'client_request_id': {'$type': 'string'}} at startup.
critical_code_review_comments: staff-auth guards look correctly layered on legacy endpoints: kitchen sees GET /orders (200) but not /reports/closing (403). Manager still full-access. Verified via 5 spot-check API tests + full UI matrix.

Kitchen UI correctly hides staff-go-admin and staff-go-closing chips based on role (see /app/frontend/app/staff/index.tsx:86-87). Good defence in depth: even if user hand-navigates to /staff/admin, backend 403 + UI degrades to empty state without crash (validated).
Phone role on /staff/ticket/<id> works as spec – ticket text renders with Source: TELEPHONE - POSTE 1 and expected sections.
Customer public flow untouched: /menu, /orders (POST), /orders/{id}, /orders?ids= all reachable without token – confirmed via guest-checkout end-to-end.
No secrets leaked in frontend bundle from what was visible in DOM/network during the run (full grep coverage is already in tests/test_security_iter8.py per the request description).

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 spot + relies on 110/110 pytest suite already passing)

Non-destructive.
